_comment: Seed library. key must match a writer's whitelist entry. season_window: preseason | in_season | playoffs | offseason | any. league_wide: true => subject_teams [] and exempt from team cooldown. Wildcard-slot formats that succeed get appended here at runtime, growing the library.
